scoredWith.ask: Think about Cow in Sharing at the Farm and Ant in Sharing in the Garden. Tell one way they are alike.

samples.text:
Here are our two stories! 

In *Sharing at the Farm*, the morning sun shined bright on the busy farm. Cow shared a big red apple with Pig. Pig shared wooden blocks to build a tall tower. Duck shared a picture book for quiet reading time. The happy animals played together until the sun went down.

In *Sharing in the Garden*, the warm wind blew softly through the green garden. Ant shared a sweet green apple with Bee. Bee shared light twigs to build a tall tower. Ladybug shared a story book for quiet reading time. The joyful bugs smiled as they shared until night time.

Think about Cow in *Sharing at the Farm* and Ant in *Sharing in the Garden*. Tell one way they are alike.
